subject: Access governance handoff — onboarding matrix
messages:
From: Alex Cortez <alex.c@arcadia-sys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@arcadia-sys.com>, security@arcadia-sys.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Access governance handoff — onboarding matrix

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the pre-kickoff call earlier. As discussed, we're starting the formal handoff from Sales to CS/Engineering for Arcadia's Redwood onboarding. To keep the go-live on schedule (target: week of Dec 6), can you confirm owners and the preferred format for the access governance matrix?

Top items we need confirmed from Redwood:
- SSO/SAML metadata exchange and signing algorithm (we currently require RSA-SHA256)
- SCIM attribute mapping (email, externalId, groups) and deprovisioning TTL
- IP allowlist ranges for the ingest endpoints and management console
- Service account naming convention and least-priv roles for automated provisioning
- Acceptance test plan and rollback window for the cutover (we have a maintenance window Dec 7 02:00-06:00 UTC)

I've attached Arcadia's proposed SCIM attribute list (arcadia_scim_attrs.csv) and a list of IP CIDRs we expect to allow. Can you loop in the CS lead and security contact on your side?

Appreciate it — want to avoid last-minute surprises on the SSO metadata shape.

Best,
Alex
Enterprise IT, Arcadia Systems
---
Attachment: arcadia_scim_attrs.csv (text/csv, 12KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Cortez <alex.c@arcadia-sys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access governance handoff — onboarding matrix

Thanks Alex — got it. Looping in the internal owners and attaching an initial access governance matrix we use for enterprise cutovers.

Quick summary / owners:
- CS Lead / PM: Monica Patel (customer-facing runbook, acceptance criteria)
- Engineering / Provisioning: Jonas Weber (service account creation, SCIM connector, test harness)
- Security / Compliance: Marissa Cole (SAML settings, cert review, IP allowlist sign-off)
- Integration Owner (Redwood): Logan Wright (overall timeline and go/no-go)

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Please confirm the SAML signing cert preference (RSA-SHA256 OK) and share the IdP metadata file.
2) Confirm which SCIM groups map to prod roles (we need exact group names for mapping).
3) Validate the maintenance window (Dec 7 02:00-06:00 UTC) as acceptable for the cutover test.

I've uploaded an editable matrix to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-onboard-matrix and attached a baseline spreadsheet (access-onboard-matrix.xlsx) that breaks down responsibilities, required artifacts, and per-step acceptance criteria.

Next steps: Monica will run a 30-min alignment call Monday to walk the matrix and lock owners. Jonas will follow with a provisioning checklist and JIRA ticket for the SCIM connector. Marissa will review the IP CIDRs and return any concerns.

Onward —
Logan Wright
Head of Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access governance handoff — onboarding matrix

Hi Alex / team,

I'll take the alignment call Monday and will prepare the acceptance checklist in advance. A couple of clarifications to speed the SCIM and SAML work:

SCIM mapping notes (proposed):
- userName -> mail (primary identifier)
- externalId -> employeeId (must be unique, immutable)
- active -> boolean (deprovisioning: immediate sync + 24h TTL for infra cleanup)
- groups -> entitlements (mapping table attached in the matrix)

Service account / provisioning rules:
- Naming pattern: redwood-{customer-short}-{env}-{purpose} (e.g., redwood-arcadia-prod-scim)
- Minimum privileges: SCIM write + read for user objects; separate mgmt account for API keys with owner tag
- Keys: short-lived tokens via our key-service with 90-day rotation policy (we can make exceptions with ops approval)

IP allowlist: please add the CSV to the shared Drive and we'll validate them against our egress lists. For management console access, we require source IPs for admin breakout; for SCIM webhook we allow the listed CIDRs.

I'll attach the SCIM schema we reference for production (scim-schema-v2.json) and will include the draft acceptance tests in the Drive doc.

See you Monday — please confirm who from Arcadia will join the 30-min alignment (IdP, SRE, and security are ideal).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
---
